BiblicalUsage: Elitsaphan or Eltsaphan is an Israelite. In Exodus 6:22, the text says "and Elzaphan." The life behind the name is told on the Elzaphan People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Elitsaphan or Eltsaphan matters because God knows His people by name, and Elitsaphan or Eltsaphan is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
